records.title: Basic Swahili
records.text: SWA 101 Basic Swahili (5) Introduces the Swahili language and the diverse cultures and customs of the people of East Africa. Provides a basic foundation in speaking, reading, and writing. First in a sequence of three. Maximum 15 credits allowed between SWA 101; SWA 102; SWA 103; and SWA 134.
